profile.primary_concern: fear of stigma and lack of access due to financial constraints

context: As a non-binary individual coping with gender dysphoria, you might feel vulnerable when approaching healthcare providers about PrEP. The fear of being misunderstood or judged could make it challenging to seek out the information you need. Additionally, financial barriers may further complicate your ability to access this preventive treatment. Your desire for safety and health is overshadowed by concerns about societal acceptance and affordability.
